text:
Ivy: hey all 1st day here. quick question: i want to run an automated smoke that toggles a flag in prod via a CI job (not me clicking the Console). i don't see the service-account options in Console. who handles svc-account creds for feature-flag API access?
Ben: welcome Ivy! :wave: Prod svc-accounts are tightly controlled. usually Platform issues a short-lived client-credentials pair scoped to the flag api for CI. do you have the CI job link and justification?
Ivy: CI job: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/infra-smoke/12. reason: verify deployment wiring post-rollout. want to call POST /api/v1/flags/rollout with a svc token for 10m.
Marta: fyi we prefer scheduled toggles from Console whenever possible because they auto-populate audit metadata. CI-driven toggles need additional review (we worry about leaked creds).
infra-bot: IAM note: svc-account issuance requires: 1) ticket PRIV-SVC 2) mgr + sec approval 3) TTL <= 2h (default 30m) 4) token rotation policy enforced. See https://docs.redwood.ai/ops/service-accounts
Ivy: ok i'll open a ticket. is there a shorter path for temporary CI-run? maybe a one-time signed url or ephemeral token?
Ben: two options: (A) ephemeral client cred issued to svc-account with TTL, audited, recommended; (B) use a runbook where infra runs the toggle on your behalf (cli + audit). For automated scheduled daily smokes, we prefer (A) with proper vetting.
Ivy: created PRIV-SVC-9: "ephemeral svc token for CI flag toggle (10m)" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRIV-SVC-9 — included CI link, dashboards, rollback, and token handling plan.
security-bot: Checklist: include threat model for token leakage, where secrets are stored (vault path), least-privilege scope (flags:rollout only), and approval from app owner. Recommend vault path: secret/ci/priv-svc/infra-smoke.
Marta: approved PRIV-SVC-9 after reviewing scope and vault plan. tagging infra to mint ephemeral creds for svc-account infra-smoke-svc.
infra-bot: issuing ephemeral creds: `mint-svc-token --svc=infra-smoke-svc --scope=flags:rollout --env=prod --ttl=00:15 --vault-path=secret/ci/priv-svc/infra-smoke --ticket=PRIV-SVC-9`
infra-bot: creds minted. vault path secret/ci/priv-svc/infra-smoke updated. audit_id=aud-ff11ee. token expires in 15m. :white_check_mark:
Ivy: added a Vault reference to CI job and ran toggle via curl: `curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/flags/rollout" -H "Authorization: Bearer $(vault read -field=token secret/ci/priv-svc/infra-smoke)" -d '{"flag":"canary_integration","pct":10}'`
Ben: nice. reminder: rotate that secret immediately and confirm CI logs don't print the token. we should also add a short postmortem entry for the issuance.
Ivy: smoke passed. rotated vault secret and verified logs.
onboard-bot: onboarding note added: "Day 1: if CI needs prod flag toggles, open PRIV-SVC ticket with vault plan".
Marta: added runbook snippet: prefer Console scheduled toggles for manual tests; use ephemeral svc tokens for automated CI with strict vault + rotation rules.
Ivy: huge thanks 1 very smooth. saved to my "first-week checklist".
